title: •••Tauntaun Handler
caption: •••Tauntaun Handler (V)
game_text: Creature vehicles he ‘rides’ are power +2. While ‘riding’ a Tauntaun, adds one battle destiny. May cancel any result of Tauntaun Bones.
lore: Corman Quien is a typical scout at Echo Base. Captured, tamed and trained the native tauntauns.
